Name: Verisk Analytics Inc
Description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. (VRSK) is a leading American data analytics and risk assessment firm headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey. With a diverse clientele spanning the insurance, natural resources, financial services, government, and risk management sectors, Verisk leverages its proprietary data sets and deep industry expertise to deliver advanced predictive analytics and decision support services. The company specializes in critical areas such as fraud detection, actuarial science, insurance coverage evaluation, catastrophe modeling, weather risk assessments, and comprehensive data management solutions, positioning itself as an invaluable partner in risk mitigation and strategic decision-making for its clients.
